description: Terminal input classification: keys, pastes, mouse and focus reports. Read by `bun test` in server/src/bridge/vt-input-classifier.test.ts.

cases.name: printable text becomes one TextCommit
enter, backspace, tab, escape keys
preserves Ctrl+J and modified Enter variants
preserves Ctrl+/ separately from the ambiguous legacy Ctrl+_ byte
does not interpret unsupported or malformed CSI-u sequences
ctrl+letter maps to Char with CONTROL
arrows and modified arrows
preserves every modified CSI key family emitted by xterm
tilde keys: delete, home, end, page up/down
function keys via SS3 and tilde
alt+char
alt-prefixed control bytes remain one modified key
bracketed paste becomes one Paste event
mixed text and keys keep order
split sequences wait for completion
split UTF-8 chars wait for completion
double ESC yields Esc then reprocesses
click, release, drag, motion and all wheel directions use pane-local cells
every split point buffers the report without leaking text; paste stays paste
rejects malformed fields, unsupported buttons, impossible kinds and out-of-range cells
encodes the frozen generation-1 mouse fields including absent geometry
encodes Ctrl+/ as a semantic slash press, not Ctrl+_
encodes the ClientShellPaneInput frame
